record.reason: Data augmentation plays a significant role in making automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems robust against unseen test data. Most of the existing data augmentation techniques are designed to work on the speech features. Augmentation of speech embeddings, within the neural network, e.g., the inputs to encoders, are relatively unexplored. We present a simple yet effective augmentation scheme, EmbedAug, which works by re-placing a set of randomly selected speech embeddings by either zeros or Gaussian noise during training. EmbedAug does not require additional data, works online during trainin
record.title: EmbedAug: An Augmentation Scheme for End-to-End Automatic Speech Recognition
